description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectActivityAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing project activities within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting project activity records, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: ProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: API controller class providing endpoints to manage project activities, including CRUD operations with validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list project activities with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new project activity.

methods.name: setParamsToProjectActivity
methods.description: Populates a ProjectActivity entity with parameters from the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: getProjectIdParamRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for projectId parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of multiple project activities based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete endpoint.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a single project activity by its ID and project ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single project activity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing project activity with provided data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for the update endpoint.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules used in creating and updating project activities.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Prepares entity uniqueness options for validation during update.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves project and activity IDs from URL parameters.
